title: Social Media Privacy Risk Calculator - Check Your Exposure
metaDescription: Calculate your privacy risk across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms. Get personalized tips to protect your data and improve settings.
description: Assess your privacy exposure across major social media platforms. This calculator evaluates your current settings, sharing habits, and data exposure to provide a comprehensive privacy risk score with actionable recommendations.

inputs.helpText: Include Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Snapchat, etc.

outputFields.description: Overall privacy risk assessment (0-100, lower is better)

formula: const platformWeight = { 1: 10, 2: 20, 3: 30, 4: 40, 5: 50 }; const visibilityWeight = { 'restricted': 5, 'private': 15, 'mixed': 35, 'public': 50 }; const infoWeight = { 'minimal': 5, 'basic': 15, 'moderate': 25, 'extensive': 40 }; const postingWeight = { 'rarely': 5, 'monthly': 10, 'weekly': 20, 'daily': 30, 'multiple': 40 }; const locationWeight = { 'never': 0, 'sometimes': 10, 'often': 25, 'always': 35 }; const reviewWeight = { 'month': 0, 'quarter': 10, 'year': 20, 'never': 30 }; const appsWeight = { 'none': 0, 'few': 5, 'several': 15, 'many': 25 }; const adWeight = { 'disabled': 0, 'limited': 10, 'default': 20, 'enabled': 30 }; const riskScore = Math.min(100, platformWeight[inputs.platformCount] + visibilityWeight[inputs.profileVisibility] + infoWeight[inputs.personalInfoShared] + postingWeight[inputs.postingFrequency] + locationWeight[inputs.locationSharing] + reviewWeight[inputs.privacySettingsReview] + appsWeight[inputs.thirdPartyApps] + adWeight[inputs.adPersonalization]); const riskLevel = riskScore <= 30 ? 'Low Risk': riskScore <= 60 ? 'Medium Risk': riskScore <= 80 ? 'High Risk': 'Critical Risk'; const dataExposure = Math.min(95, Math.round(riskScore * 0.8 + Math.random() * 10)); return { riskScore, riskLevel, dataExposure };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your social media privacy risk by analyzing platform usage, profile visibility, information sharing patterns, location data, privacy settings maintenance, third-party app connections, and advertising personalization. Each factor is weighted based on typical privacy exposure risks and data harvesting practices across major platforms.
tips: Review and update privacy settings on all platforms at least quarterly, as platforms frequently change their default settings
Use private browsing modes like a privacy-focused browser when accessing social media to limit tracking cookies and data collection
Regularly audit connected third-party apps and remove any you no longer use - they often retain access to your data indefinitely
Disable location sharing for posts and in platform settings to prevent building detailed location profiles
Consider using separate email addresses for social media accounts to limit data linking across services

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
